'''Trinity Rodman''' is an American soccer player. The daughter of basketball player [[Dennis Rodman]], she was drafted by the [[Washington Spirit]] as the second overall pick in the 2021 [[National Women's Soccer League]] draft.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.cnn.com/2021/01/14/us/trinity-rodman-draft-nwsl-spt-trnd/?hpt=ob_blogfooterold |title=Trinity Rodman, daughter of the NBA legend, drafted 2nd overall in pro soccer league|first1=Travis|last1=Caldwell|publisher=[[CNN]]|date=January 14, 2021
